answer: Each agent identity must stake a bond in a registry whose recorded entry a forge cannot duplicate without a one-per-hardware credential. An attacker creating 1,000 fake identities locks 50,000 units and waits 30 epochs, with 90 percent slashed on detection. Copying one credential across many identities raises marginal cost per fake, and a shared penalty joins every copy to the same tide of slashing, so independent jurors confirm the garden of honest stakes holds.
